hints.title: Innermost Expression Evaluation
hints.text: Nested parentheses suggest evaluating subexpressions from inside out as soon as a closing parenthesis is reached.

hints.title: Delimiter Skipping
hints.text: Commas and open parentheses can either be skipped or used as delimiters between operators and operands.

hints.title: Operator Resolution
hints.text: When seeing a closing parenthesis, collect all boolean terms back to the open parenthesis, apply the preceding operator, and store the resulting boolean value.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regular expressions or standard substring replacement cannot handle arbitrary depth recursion and operator precedence cleanly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A LIFO evaluation structure matches each nested block and processes all characters in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle operator evaluation cleanly without leaking delimiters or misordering nested subexpressions.
